headline: Secret 'Kindness Mob' Counters Trolls With Waves of Support
meta_description: After cruel comments flooded a weight loss video, a group of around half a million kind strangers rallied to restore the creator's confidence.
summary_short: When trolls attacked Kahri Salyars' weight loss video with hundreds of cruel comments, a 'Kindness Mob' of roughly half a million people flooded her with compliments.
body:
When Kahri Salyars posted a weight loss video, hundreds of cruel comments arrived almost immediately. But something unexpected happened next: a secret "Kindness Mob" mobilized to counter the negativity, flooding her with genuine compliments and encouragement.

The group, numbering around half a million members, turned what could have been a devastating moment into an opportunity for collective compassion. Their coordinated response didn't just drown out the trolls—it actively restored Salyars' confidence when she needed it most.

The story reveals how online communities, when organized around kindness rather than cruelty, possess genuine power to heal. In an era when negativity spreads quickly, this "Kindness Mob" chose a different path: to meet hurt with support, and to remind creators that strangers can be allies too.
quick_facts: Kahri Salyars received hundreds of cruel comments on a weight loss video
A secret 'Kindness Mob' countered the trolls with compliments
The supportive group has around half a million members
The coordinated response helped restore Salyars' confidence
